name: netflix-graphql-gateway
description: Federated GraphQL Gateway inspired by Netflix Studio Edge — 3 subgraphs, OpenTelemetry tracing, field-level analytics

scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --workspace=subgraphs/users" "npm run start --workspace=subgraphs/content" "npm run start --workspace=subgraphs/billing" "npm run start --workspace=gateway" "npm run start --workspace=dashboard"
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "users,content,billing,gateway,dashboard" --prefix-colors "blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan" "npm run dev --workspace=subgraphs/users" "npm run dev --workspace=subgraphs/content" "npm run dev --workspace=subgraphs/billing" "npm run dev --workspace=gateway" "npm run dev --workspace=dashboard"
